summary: EVAVO's governed art-production, source-review, mastering, pixel-font, delivery, provider-routing and runtime-validation authority. Art Studio can prepare and validate bounded creative assets, but Git mutation and mainline publication remain delegated to EVAVO GitHub MCP and Development Studio.

capabilities.title: Inventory and visually review immutable source art
capabilities.description: Inventory RAW_ART, build bounded visual catalogues and prepare reviewed source-safe work sessions without modifying owner-supplied originals.
requires: Human or governed-agent visual decisions before promotion

capabilities.title: Create governed Project Art workspaces
capabilities.description: Compile and execute path-bounded intake plans, retain immutable originals and working copies, and expose persistent Project Art workspace tools without transferring media bytes through MCP.

capabilities.title: Master frames, motion and deterministic atlases
capabilities.description: Validate alpha and frame assurance, build deterministic sprite atlases and engine metadata, and review motion and loop closure while preserving source evidence.

capabilities.title: Build and finalise bounded art review evidence
capabilities.description: Compile, build and finalise review packages with deterministic evidence and a read-oriented MCP surface; review completion does not itself approve or publish runtime assets.
requires: Explicit review decision for any later promotion

capabilities.title: Build original deterministic pixel-font families
capabilities.description: Author, audit, build, compare and validate independent EVAVO pixel-font masters and deterministic BMFont, PNG, BDF, JSON, grid and convenience derivative outputs.

capabilities.title: Prepare web, image, audio and Godot delivery assets
capabilities.description: Run governed web-asset processing, delivery optimisation, audio delivery and Godot sprite-effect tooling with exact source and output evidence.

capabilities.title: Plan and admit governed provider work
capabilities.description: Compile provider runtime profiles, production queues, style profiles, workspace jobs, selection and admission evidence without treating planning or admission as provider execution or publication.
requires: Separate execution authorization for live work

capabilities.title: Execute explicitly authorised provider jobs
capabilities.description: Run bounded provider workers only after exact plan, environment and per-call execution gates; provider receipts prove local or provider work only and confer no Git or mainline publication authority.
requires: Exact authorised plan and expected source hashes

capabilities.title: Serve bounded read-oriented Art Studio MCP review tools
capabilities.description: Build and serve the review MCP profile for bounded inspection, planning and evidence access without granting general workspace, provider or publication mutation.

capabilities.title: Serve separately gated Art Studio production MCP tools
capabilities.description: Build and serve production or workspace-writer MCP profiles whose write, provider and execution effects remain individually gated and do not include Git publication.

capabilities.title: Validate book-art creative direction
capabilities.description: Validate repository-owned book creative-direction contracts and integration boundaries without generating an approval or publication decision.

capabilities.title: Run complete Art Studio validation
capabilities.description: Run exact toolchain, media, Project Art, RAW_ART, provider, type, test and build validation while retaining repository cleanliness and negative-authority boundaries.
requires: Python and pinned image-toolchain requirements where media checks run

topics: sprite identity, motion and loop continuity
alpha, atlas and runtime media correctness
provider routing, execution gates and receipts
negative authority, recovery and publication boundaries
